title: RideLink Booking Channels, Notice and Trip Timing by Level
content:
This table from the Non-Emergency Medical Transportation chapter of the Member Handbook sets out, for each RideLink level of service, how trips are booked, how far ahead, the urgent and hospital discharge pickup times, the hours trips run, shared riding, the earliest drop-off and the will-call return pickup time. A figure of 0 means the service it measures is not offered on that level.

## Booking

| Level | Booking channels | Routine notice (business days) | Booked at most (calendar days ahead) | Urgent same-day trips |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RideLink Transit Pass | Phone, member portal | 0 | 30 | No |
| RideLink Mileage Reimbursement | Phone, member portal | 2 | 30 | No |
| RideLink Ambulatory Sedan | Phone, member portal, mobile app | 2 | 30 | Yes |
| RideLink Door-to-Door Assist | Phone, member portal, mobile app | 2 | 30 | Yes |
| RideLink Wheelchair Van | Phone, member portal, mobile app | 3 | 30 | Yes |
| RideLink Stretcher Van | Phone only | 3 | 30 | Yes |

Routine notice counts business days — Monday to Friday, excluding state holidays — between the booking date and the appointment date.

## Trip timing

| Level | Urgent pickup within (hours) | Hospital discharge pickup within (hours) | Trip service hours | Shared rides | Most time on board a shared trip (minutes) | Earliest drop-off before the appointment (minutes) | Will-call return pickup within (minutes of the call) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| RideLink Transit Pass | 0 | 0 | Not applicable | No | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| RideLink Mileage Reimbursement | 0 | 0 | Not applicable | No | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| RideLink Ambulatory Sedan | 3 | 3 | 05:00-21:00 | Yes | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| RideLink Door-to-Door Assist | 3 | 3 | 05:00-21:00 | Yes | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| RideLink Wheelchair Van | 3 | 3 | 05:00-21:00 | Yes | 75 | 60 | 90 |
| RideLink Stretcher Van | 4 | 3 | 00:00-23:59 | No | 90 | 60 | 120 |

## Questions the table answers

- **Can a RideLink Stretcher Van trip be booked through the app?** No; that level books by phone only.
- **What is the longest a member rides on a shared RideLink Wheelchair Van trip?** 75 minutes. RideLink Stretcher Van trips are not shared, although the level lists 90 minutes as its most time on board.
- **How soon is an urgent trip picked up?** Within 3 hours on RideLink Ambulatory Sedan, RideLink Door-to-Door Assist and RideLink Wheelchair Van, and within 4 hours on RideLink Stretcher Van; the transit and mileage levels offer no urgent same-day trip.
- **When may a trip be booked at the earliest?** No more than 30 calendar days ahead of the appointment date on every level.
